describe: Illustrated pastel-lilac futuristic city plaza in soft daylight: a glossy tiled floor with faint concentric light rings running across the whole width, a skyline of translucent violet/blue domed towers and spires behind, a large ringed planet at the upper left, small floating shards and star sparkles in a pale blue sky. Centre-left of the plaza holds a purple holographic pedestal projecting a glowing blue user-avatar hologram. The boy stands on the left of the pedestal, the white-and-blue robot Nova on the right; both are lit from the front with soft reflections on the floor beneath them.
